Use PHP 8.4+ syntax only. Add `declare(strict_types=1);` to every PHP file. Make all classes final unless inheritance is required. Use readonly properties wherever possible, constructor property promotion, typed properties and return types, and PSR-12. Never use `var_dump()` or `dd()` in production code.

Base: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk`; Data: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk.Data`; Requests: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk.Requests`; Enums: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk.Enums`. DTOs are `final readonly`; Requests are `final`, extend `Saloon\Http\Request`, and use typed Data DTO responses. Enums are backed enums with string or int values. Use traits (see `Traits/`): `HasPaginationParams`, `HasFieldParams`, `HasIdParams`. Member-only requests must use `RequiresMemberAuth`.

Public API: GET, read-only, no auth. Member API: POST/PUT/DELETE, member data, or DOI modifications. Add:
`use VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk\Traits\Requests\RequiresMemberAuth;`

`final class CreateDOI extends Request`
`use RequiresMemberAuth;  // Enforces member auth requirement`
`protected Method $method = Method::POST;`

Run these commands before committing:
`composer test`
`composer lint`
`composer test:unit`
`composer test:types`
`composer refactor`
